test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 4% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate (R) = 4% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculation:**

dfrac{2500 times 4 times 4}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{2500 times 16}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹400

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
